rationale: Ports pause/resume/rotation hooks into camera_apple.mm, but that module is absent on HEAD (only camera_macos exists), so it needs the 4.7 camera_apple backport first.
Fixes an hb_raster_draw_glyph call, but the hb_raster color-glyph path does not exist on HEAD (HarfBuzz 12.3.2, no hb_raster_* anywhere), so it needs the hb-raster rendering rework first.
Both .gitignore files still exist on HEAD and reference the already-removed gdextension_build/godot-cpp dir, so deleting these dead files is trivial and safe.
Guards a from_bitmap variable used only by the HB_VERSION_ATLEAST(13) hb_raster path, which is absent on HEAD, so the fix has no target until the hb-raster rework lands.
Adds a HINTING_NONE condition to the hb_raster is_rasterized path, which does not exist on HEAD (no hb_raster_draw_* code), so it depends on the hb-raster rework.
Rewrites variable-font transform handling inside the hb_raster paint/draw blocks, which are entirely absent on HEAD, so it needs the hb-raster rendering path first.
Moves the hb_rdr/hb_mono raster contexts to per-font and adds an FT_Render_Glyph fallback, but the whole hb_raster infrastructure is absent on HEAD, so it depends on the hb-raster rework.

The gdextension_build dirs are already gone from HEAD but the #ifdef GDEXTENSION guards and GDE_EXPORT init code remain (rebranded to Foundry); removing them is desirable dead-code cleanup but non-urgent and spans 19 rebrand-diverged files.
The start_with_obj embedded-object language-merge logic is already present verbatim at text_server_adv.cpp:6282, so it is already on HEAD.
HEAD still has req.width = sz * 64.0 in both text_server_adv and text_server_fb _ensure_cache_for_size; clamping to MIN(2048.0, sz) is a self-contained two-line fix that applies cleanly.

Large restructure moving FT_Face/FT_Size from per-size to per-font across 4 files (~250 lines) overlapping the fork-diverged _ensure_cache_for_size region, so it needs careful reconciliation, not a clean cherry-pick.
COMBINING_ENCLOSING_KEYCAP is already defined and used in the emoji-run check in script_iterator.cpp at lines 38 and 111, so it is already on HEAD.
HEAD still uses the narrow 0x200B-0x200D zero-width check in TextServerFallback::_shaped_text_shape; the preserve_control field exists, so the wider ZWSP/word-joiner/BOM handling applies cleanly.
The no-video-stream branch in set_file at video_stream_theora.cpp:422 still silently returns without clearing vorbis state; the vc/vi/vo cleanup and error match the surrounding HEAD code exactly.
